index.description: L2 index of workflow recipes. A recipe is a platform-neutral F027 pipeline `faion workflow build` compiles into a Claude Dynamic Workflow and a Codex chain. The retriever reads this to pick a pipeline shape, then reads that recipe's card — the card is the contract and is enough to invoke from; recipe.json is the compiler's input, not the agent's. Authoring rules: recipes/AGENTS.md.

recipe.name: article-pipeline
recipe.summary: Workflow recipe: longform article from an editorial brief — outline, per-section fan-out, assembly, gated editorial pass, translation and language review. Composes the article-* fragments with the gate-* trio.

recipe.name: audit-and-fix
recipe.summary: Workflow recipe: audit an existing tree and repair only what the audit blocks — bootstrap, machine checks, cited review, bounded fix gate. Four stages, no fan-out; the smallest recipe in the catalog.

recipe.name: research-first-build
recipe.summary: Workflow recipe: greenfield build that researches before it decides — three named catalogs, a quantified concept pick, design, SDD plan, per-task fan-out, asset pass, bootstrap gate, independent review, bounded fix loop. Composes build-*, sdd-* and gate-* fragments.

recipe.name: sdd-feature
recipe.summary: Workflow recipe: one SDD feature from intake to reviewed, gated implementation — analyze, plan, bootstrap, per-task fan-out over isolated worktrees, independent review, bounded fix loop. Composes the sdd-* and gate-* fragments.
